common.somethingWrong: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
common.offline: You look to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
common.busy: Colyv is busy right now. Nothing was changed. Try again in a few seconds.

signIn.title: Sign in to Colyv
signIn.subtitle: Every brand and creator deal, on the record.
signIn.creator: Creator
signIn.creatorHint: Find campaigns, do the work, confirm you were paid.
signIn.brandHint: Post campaigns, choose creators, keep every deal on record.
signIn.phoneHint: We send a 6-digit code to this number. We never share it.
signIn.phoneInvalid: Enter a 10-digit Indian mobile number. It starts with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
signIn.safety: Colyv never asks you to share your login code.
signIn.roleMissing: Choose whether you are a creator or a brand. It decides which account you open.
signIn.roleNote: A new number opens a new account for the role you choose.

code.title: Enter your code
code.label: 6-digit code
code.resendIn: Send a new code in {seconds} s
code.invalid: That code is wrong, has expired or was already used. Check it, or send a new code.
code.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait {seconds} s, then try again.
code.rateLimitedNoWait: Too many tries. Wait a little, then try again.
code.suspended: This account is suspended. If you think that is a mistake, contact support and quote the reference below.
code.roleConflict: This number cannot sign in as a {role} right now. Check the number, or try the other role.
code.phoneChangeWaiting: An account is waiting to move onto this number. Sign in with that account's current number until the change is made.
code.safety: Colyv never asks you to share this code with anyone.
